label: Phase two — the pattern registers
location: The Sunken Mire, at the spawning pools

recentEvents.value: It showed him the bank. He looked at the bank, and kept wading. The mire does not call this malice. It calls this data.

unresolvedConflicts.value: The boundary is the peace. He keeps crossing it.

temporaryObjective.value: Rise earlier. Meet him shallower. Carry him to the bank.

notes: Deliberate deviation from the other bosses: no fact_amulet_translation_is_accurate here — per its profile it registers his presence, not his words, and the fact sits in unknown.
